Your business knowledge, put to work

Helpful answers start with what you know.

Give the assistant the information you want customers to receive: services, opening hours, locations, policies and the questions your team answers every day.

Agree the tone, test the answers and keep the source information current. When something is missing, uncertain or personal, the next step should be a person, not a guess.

Explore AI support →
A practical knowledge checklist
01What you offerServices, useful details and approved pricing
02How you workHours, locations and customer policies
03When to ask a personExceptions, uncertainty and sensitive questions
04How you stay currentNamed content owner and regular review

Approved information → configured answers → team review

Available beyond the front desk

After-hours support.
Human responsibility.

AI can be configured to respond around the clock on supported connected channels. That means 24/7 assistance for suitable questions, not a promise that every issue is resolved immediately.

Keep routine answers consistent

Use the same approved business information across configured AI conversations. Review the answers as your services, policies and opening hours change.

Make the handoff intentional

Agree what AI can handle, when it should stop and who receives the conversation. Tell customers what to expect when your people are unavailable.

Share the workload clearly

Use the team inbox, assigned conversations and followed conversations to keep responsibility visible. Agree a daily review for enquiries that still need attention.

Connect the next useful action

Move from a conversation to a booking request, quotation or follow-up task where configured. Let people confirm availability, commitments and exceptions.

The setup makes the difference.

AI behaviour, channel support, operating availability and handoff rules depend on configuration, provider policies and the selected plan. Human support hours are agreed separately. AI responses should be tested and reviewed; they can be incomplete or incorrect.

A few useful answers.

Will every channel work with my account?

Not automatically. The channels shown are examples of the intended journey. AyudaGrow needs to confirm account eligibility, connection method, messaging permissions, response windows and any additional charges for your setup.

Does a shared inbox mean the same customer is always recognised?

No. Conversation history depends on the connected channel and how contact records are matched. Agree how your team handles duplicate records and identity checks. Moving between channels does not guarantee one automatically merged history.

Can my team take over from AI?

Human handoff is part of the workflow to define and test. Agree the triggers, assignment, notifications and how automated replies pause when a person takes responsibility. Exact controls depend on configuration and available features.

Is everything included in one price?

The scope and selected plan determine what is included. Channels, AI usage, messaging, setup and ongoing support may have separate charges. Confirm these before activation.
